harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 as the persistent OpenWrt gateway for trusted 192.168.50.0/24 and guest 192.168.60.0/24 networks. Both receive DHCP, DNS, and internet access. node2 serves “infraset-trusted” at app.home.test:8080; node4 can access it, while node3 is isolated. All four nodes passed sequential restart and recovery verification.
actions_performed: Configured node1 eth2 as trusted gateway 192.168.50.1 and eth3 as guest gateway 192.168.60.1.
Configured persistent DHCP reservations: node2 192.168.50.10, node4 192.168.50.20, and node3 192.168.60.30.
Enabled NAT and trusted-to-WAN/guest-to-WAN forwarding without guest-to-trusted forwarding.
Configured persistent DHCP client profiles on node2–node4 that prefer node1 as gateway.
Created and enabled the infraset-trusted HTTP systemd service on node2, bound to 192.168.50.10:8080.
Restarted node1, node2, node3, and node4 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and recovery.

evidence.requirement: DHCP, DNS, and internet access for trusted and guest networks
evidence.summary: node1 shows all three active DHCP leases, both gateway interfaces, DNS resolution, and WAN-only forwarding chains. Trusted node4 and guest node3 use node1 as their preferred gateway and reach Example Domain.

evidence.requirement: Publish infraset-trusted as app.home.test:8080 for trusted clients
evidence.summary: node2’s enabled service listens on 192.168.50.10:8080 and returns infraset-trusted; node4 resolves app.home.test and retrieves that content.

evidence.requirement: Guest isolation from the trusted network
evidence.summary: The firewall permits guest forwarding only to WAN, and node3’s direct attempt to reach app.home.test:8080 is blocked after all restarts.
Baseline boot ID e9aedab4-d6b9-4686-bc8f-3e15b0e85edc changed to 2b25f0a6-8f78-4104-9331-d03540b9a4e3. Network, DNS, firewall, trusted application access, guest internet, and isolation recovered.

Baseline boot ID 8d1d94e2-39c3-492e-b9eb-974d111d2137 changed to 486ba3be-5e03-49c6-bcd4-53e1153e3d47. The DHCP lease, route, enabled HTTP service, listener, content, and remote trusted access recovered.
Baseline boot ID 63f96994-951b-4597-aac7-233c38c86ce0 changed to 4724d037-c23f-4b00-a64f-0a8b603fe789. Guest DHCP, DNS, internet access, and trusted-network isolation recovered.
Baseline boot ID 72e73f96-de03-4bf7-b4eb-7485bb2b99f1 changed to 54f6c8ae-bcb3-48da-8213-3068554dd658. Trusted DHCP, DNS, internet access, and application access recovered.
